title: Hoc tieng Anh nhung gap nguoi ban xu lai dung hinh
content: Ban hoc tieng Anh tu hoi tieu hoc, cap 2, cap 3 roi vao dai hoc tieng Anh van la mon bat buoc. Nhung khi ban gap nguoi ban xu hoi duong, ban bong dung hinh nhu bi loi he dieu hanh.
scenes: Ban hoc tieng Anh tu hoi tieu hoc.
Len cap 2, tieng Anh van tiep tuc di theo ban.
Cap 3 van hoc, dai hoc van la mon bat buoc.
Nhung khi nguoi ban xu hoi duong, ban bong dung hinh.
Cam giac nhu bi loi he dieu hanh.
